section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (Study X) with 262 women and 278 men (total N = 540) recruited from Jakarta, Indonesia. Participants ranged in age from 19 to 75 years (M = 43.19, SD = 12.95) and had BMI values from 13.52 to 35.65 kg/m2 (M = 22.08, SD = 4.38); ethnic composition was 48.1% Javanese, 43.7% Sundanese, and 8.1% Chinese.
